independent_findings.statement: All 33 Stage 1 mathematical entries are assigned exactly once across nine bounded lineage components.
The nonlinear first-order CP-NLSE and the recorded linear second-order CE-NWE are not source-bound as exactly equivalent full equations.
The CP-NLSE zero-coupling dispersion and the UCFF zero-coupling squared dispersion coincide after squaring and a common wavenumber convention; this does not establish full formulation equivalence.
The recorded CE-NWE and UCFF lam=0 squared dispersions coincide only under the explicit conditional map g_eff=g*rho0, which the source set does not establish as a universal parameter identity.
Writing q=g_eff*rho0, the reported additive nonzero-interaction omega formula differs from the squared expression by q^2 and therefore is not an equivalent convention as written.
The two chi branches remain parallel and insufficiently defined because the full high-order equation, common coupling functional, and transformation or revision evidence are absent.

The LCRD v3 lock supplies one explicit phenomenological R/K branch, but the source set supplies neither a variational derivation nor a reproducible LSDA coarse-graining map nor a complete alternative branch.

No source-bound revised-descendant or supersession relation is established because the historical files share one archive-ingestion commit and only the review-to-monograph relationship is explicit in the source text.
The result preserves the current crosswalk, admissibility, residual, and variational packets as planning surfaces rather than treating them as descendants of a selected historical formulation.
The stage result reconciles lineage and conflict status without selecting a formulation, assigning operational meaning, repairing equations, or constructing a core, action, seam, or observable.

nonclaim_boundary: The review accepts lineage and conflict classification, not scientific truth or physical validity.
No CP-NLSE, CE-NWE, UCFF, chi, or LCRD branch is preferred or promoted.
Limited dispersion equivalence is not generalized beyond the stated parameter and domain mappings.
Missing equations, definitions, coefficient provenance, and operational meanings remain missing.
No minimal core, representation, field, action, matter or gravity seam, observable, or empirical claim is produced.
Stage 3 remains selected but unauthorized and unopened.
